text:
maya: quick sync. i'm proposing a small 'proxy-token' shim to tighten scope on project API keys without a full RBAC rewrite. mint short-lived signed tokens (ed25519) with compact route-group ids. runtime validates signature locally.

alex: ok. how does migration avoid customer outages?

maya: phased: discovery -> warn -> enforce. gateway can mint tokens on behalf of legacy keys during discovery. runtime accepts both.

sam: what about long-running jobs?

maya: two classes: interactive (5m ttl) and machine (up to 12h) with enrollment and audit.

irene: ops needs metrics: tokens_minted, legacy_usage_pct, rejected_routes. add X-Migration-Mode header.

alex: crypto/rotation: store signing key in KMS, runtimes cache pubkeys by kid. plan ed25519.

deploy-bot: canary minted proxy token for svc-payments in staging at 2024-09-13T10:10Z :white_check_mark:

sam: next: draft a short RFC with token format, route-group registry, revocation approach. i'll own rollout checklist. maya, please post RFC by Thursday.

maya: will do. aim for low-friction rollout and good telemetry so we can iterate. :thumbsup:
